name: playwright-xray-ci-template
description: Production-ready Playwright enterprise automation template with Xray Cloud CI/CD integration

scripts.ci:smoke: npm run test:smoke && TEST_TYPE=SMOKE npm run xray:upload
scripts.ci:regression: npm run test:regression && TEST_TYPE=REGRESSION npm run xray:upload
scripts.ci:full: npm run test:full && TEST_TYPE=FULL npm run xray:upload
